2026 May 13th

Motivation: territorial disparities and policy relevance

  • Italy exhibits persistent territorial divides in infrastructure, services, and outcomes

  • PNRR / NextGenerationEU and GRINS: demand for granular, data-informed territorial planning

  • Research quest: quantify local disparities through interpretable models

  • Method of analysis: parametric and uncertainty-informed statistical modelling

Methodological framework

  • Areal modelling: spatial domain described through adjacency graphs \(\Rightarrow\) CAR-like (Besag 1974) and convolution (Besag, York, and Mollié 1991) latent models

  • Bayesian inference for interpretable uncertainty, flexible prior setup and model comparison

  • Computation: Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (Rue, Martino, and Chopin 2009), (Van Niekerk and Rue 2024)

  • Recurring issues: hyperprior interpretability \(\Rightarrow\) Penalised complexity priors (Simpson et al. 2017); Spatial confounding \(\Rightarrow\) Spatial+2.0 filtering (Urdangarin et al. 2024)

Chapter 1: SchoolDataIT

  • Policy and research need: harmonised, georeferenced open data regarding school infrastructure and student outcomes

  • Available data come from multiple providers in heterogeneous formats \(\Rightarrow\) missing harmonisation

  • Contribution: an R package that retrieves, cleans, harmonises, and maps data at LAU / NUTS-3 level

  • Package available on CRAN, under version 0.2.12

Data providens

  • Ministry of Education: National school registry, school buildings database, classroom size, teachers per class

  • INVALSI: census survey indicators \(\Rightarrow\) spatially homogeneous indicator of student outcomes

  • ISTAT: inner areas taxonomy \(\Rightarrow\) synthetic indicator of municipality infrastructural state

  • Infratel/MIMIT: ultra-broadband activation status

Cited works

Besag, Julian. 1974. “Spatial Interaction and the Statistical Analysis of Lattice Systems.” Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series B (Methodological) 36 (2): 192–225. https://doi.org/10.1111/j.2517-6161.1974.tb00999.x.

Besag, Julian, Jeremy York, and Annie Mollié. 1991. “Bayesian Image Restoration, with Two Applications in Spatial Statistics.” Annals of the Institute of Statistical Mathematics 43: 1–20. https://doi.org/10.1007/BF00116466.

Rue, Håvard, Sara Martino, and Nicholas Chopin. 2009. “Approximate Bayesian Inference for Latent Gaussian Models by Using Integrated Nested Laplace Approximations.” Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series B: (Methodological) 71 (2): 319–92. https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1467-9868.2008.00700.x.

Simpson, Daniel, Håvard Rue, Andrea Riebler, Thiago G. Martins, and Sigrunn H. Sørbye. 2017. “Penalising Model Component Complexity: A Principled, Practical Approach to Constructing Priors.” Statistical Science 32 (1): 1–28. https://doi.org/10.1214/16-STS576.

Urdangarin, Arantxa, Tomas Goicoa, Thomas Kneib, and Maria Dolores Ugarte. 2024. “A Simplified Spatial+ Approach to Mitigate Spatial Confounding in Multivariate Spatial Areal Models.” Spatial Statistics 59: 100804. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.spasta.2023.100804.

Van Niekerk, Janet, and Håvard Rue. 2024. “Low-Rank Variational Bayes Correction to the Laplace Method.” The Journal of Machine Learning Research 25 (62): 1–25. http://jmlr.org/papers/v25/21-1405.html.
